label: New York Wing
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3.25 in (wings 3.25 in, as patch-new-york-wing); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: CAP Brand Tools repository (CAP subordinate graphic generator), Roman Vitanza; emblemoptions.js entry "New York" (Wing), path wing/nyemblem.webp. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (VP8L lossless) -> png via dwebp; trimmed to its alpha bounding box only (714 x 699 px to 714 x 699 px), no resampling, no colour change.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured.
